DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding jaundice (likely exacerbated by insufficient intake).

Based on the history of 2 days of increasing jaundice in a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with normal birth weight but potential weight gain issues, this appears to be breastfeeding jaundice.
